# Ironclad Commercial Floors

> Commercial Flooring Experts in Vancouver, BC across Metro Vancouver. Ironclad Commercial Floors is a commercial flooring contractor offering installation, repair and replacement of epoxy, polished concrete, luxury vinyl, sheet vinyl, rubber, carpet and tile floors for offices, schools, clinics, restaurants, retail, warehouses and strata buildings. Free on-site estimates; open 24 hours.

Business: IRONCLAD COMMERCIAL FLOORS
Address: 783 E 60th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5X 2A5, Canada
Phone: (604) 540-3999
Email: info@ironcladcommercialfloors.ca
Google Business Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/RvWaqdfoddTgzFLZA
Service area: Vancouver, Downtown Vancouver, Gastown, Yaletown, Mount Pleasant, Burnaby, Metrotown, New Westminster, Queensborough, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam (Metro Vancouver, BC)

## Concrete & Epoxy services

- [Commercial Epoxy Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-epoxy-flooring-vancouver): Seamless, chemical-resistant epoxy systems for plants, labs, shops and back-of-house areas that need a tough, easy-clean floor.
- [Garage Epoxy Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-garage-epoxy-flooring-vancouver): Hot-tire-resistant epoxy and polyaspartic coatings for parkades, dealership service bays, fleet garages and residential garages.
- [Concrete Floor Polishing in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-concrete-floor-polishing-vancouver): Mechanically ground, densified and polished concrete — a low-maintenance, high-gloss floor for retail, offices and warehouses.
- [Commercial Concrete Sealing in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-concrete-sealing-vancouver): Penetrating sealers and densifiers that dust-proof, harden and protect commercial and industrial slabs without changing their look.
- [Metallic & Flake Epoxy Floors in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-metallic-flake-epoxy-vancouver): Decorative metallic marble and full-broadcast flake epoxy floors that combine showroom style with commercial durability.
- [Anti-Slip Safety Coatings in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-anti-slip-safety-coatings-vancouver): Textured anti-slip coatings, safety lines and hazard markings for ramps, kitchens, loading docks and wet production areas.

## Resilient & Vinyl services

- [Commercial Flooring Installation in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-flooring-installation-vancouver): Turnkey commercial flooring installs — VCT, vinyl, carpet, tile and base — managed by one crew from substrate prep to handover.
- [Luxury Vinyl (LVT / LVP) Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-luxury-vinyl-lvt-lvp-vancouver): Luxury vinyl tile and plank with realistic wood and stone visuals and commercial wear layers — waterproof, quiet and refined.
- [Commercial Sheet Vinyl Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-sheet-vinyl-vancouver): Heat-welded homogeneous and heterogeneous sheet vinyl for healthcare, labs and schools that need a seamless, hygienic floor.
- [Commercial Rubber Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-rubber-flooring-vancouver): Rubber tile, sheet and stair treads for gyms, schools, healthcare and transit areas that need resilience, grip and sound control.
- [Integral Flash Coving in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-integral-flash-coving-vancouver): Sheet flooring run up the wall over a cove former and capped — a seamless floor-to-wall seal for healthcare, labs and kitchens.
- [Baseboard & Moisture Barriers in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-baseboard-moisture-barriers-vancouver): Rubber and vinyl wall base plus slab moisture mitigation systems that protect walls and keep new floors bonded.

## Tile & Carpet services

- [Commercial Carpet Tile Installation in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-carpet-tile-vancouver): Modular carpet tile for offices, libraries and boardrooms — comfortable, quiet and replaceable one tile at a time.
- [Broadloom Carpet Installation in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-broadloom-carpet-installation-vancouver): Wall-to-wall broadloom for hotels, corridors, theatres and executive suites — stretched or glued down with invisible seams.
- [Ceramic & Porcelain Tile Installation in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-ceramic-porcelain-tile-vancouver): Large-format porcelain and ceramic tile for lobbies, washrooms and retail — set flat, crack-isolated and built to last.
- [Commercial Quarry Tile in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-quarry-tile-vancouver): Dense, slip-resistant quarry tile with epoxy grout and cove for commercial kitchens, food processing and wet areas.
- [Entryway Walk-Off Systems in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-entryway-walk-off-systems-vancouver): Recessed entrance grilles, walk-off carpet tile and matting that stop rain, grit and salt at the door.
- [Acoustic Subfloor Systems in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-acoustic-subfloor-systems-vancouver): Acoustic underlayments and isolation systems that cut impact noise under LVT, tile, wood and carpet in multi-storey buildings.

## Sectors & Repairs services

- [Warehouse & Logistics Floors in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-warehouse-logistics-floors-vancouver): Densified, coated and striped floors for distribution centres and logistics hubs — built for forklifts and 24/7 operations.
- [Restaurant & Kitchen Flooring in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-restaurant-kitchen-flooring-vancouver): Front-of-house style and back-of-house toughness — LVT, tile, quarry and urethane cement floors for restaurants and kitchens.
- [Commercial Flooring Repair in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-flooring-repair-vancouver): Targeted repairs for lifting vinyl, failed seams, cracked tile, damaged carpet and worn coatings — without replacing the whole floor.
- [Commercial Floor Replacement in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-floor-replacement-vancouver): Complete tear-out and replacement of worn commercial floors — planned, phased and finished around your operations.
- [Joint, Spall & Crack Stitching Repair in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-joint-spall-crack-stitching-vancouver): Structural crack stitching, spall repair and joint rebuilding that restore damaged concrete slabs and stop further breakdown.
- [Demolition & Self-Leveling Floors in Vancouver, BC](https://ironclad-surface-studio.lovable.app/commercial-demolition-self-leveling-vancouver): Flooring demolition, adhesive removal, grinding and self-levelling underlayments that create the flat base every new floor needs.
